$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Media viewer

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Look closely at the media of one item.
useFor: Zooming into the media of an item.

forbidden: Cart or buy actions on top of the photo.

allowed: Image Gallery (single or multiple images) with Pagination.
forbidden: Text or badges over the photo.

rules: Each photo has alt text that describes the item.
Position is announced, not shown by dots alone.
Close returns to the same photo on the item page.
Pinch and double tap zoom; a button offers the same.

allocation.App level: L4 · detail of the item page.
allocation.Motion: Swipe has a tap alternative; reduced motion is respected (M10).

measure.success: Item views that open the viewer

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.
